overview: This House resolution set the procedure for the House's handling of a Senate-passed version of H.R. 7147, a spending bill providing further government funding for the budget year ending September 30, 2026. Resolutions like this, written by the House Rules Committee, govern how a bill reaches the floor. Adopting it meant the House was treated as agreeing to the Senate's changes, but with its own further amendment, the text of Rules Committee Print 119-21, which sent the bill back to the Senate. The House adopted the resolution on March 27, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution gave the House a quick path to respond to the Senate and keep the government funding process moving.
against: Critics say rules like this let the House approve a large spending package in a single step, without a separate vote or open amendments on its contents.
